description: Transcript export: who may export and the file produced.

preconditions: Transcript is Completed with two segments; actor is the current chair.
SPEAKER_00 is assigned to a named member.
cases.inputs: recordingId: a recording with a Completed transcript; actorId: the current chair.
cases.return: Success with a text file named ban-go-bang-<date>.txt; header says what it is and that a machine wrote it, then one [time] speaker: text line per segment.
cases.log: Saved: audit row records the export with the segment count.

preconditions: Transcript is Completed; actor takes part in the meeting but is neither chair nor secretary.
cases.inputs: recordingId: a recording with a Completed transcript; actorId: an ordinary member.
cases.return: Failure ExportForbidden (MSG355 "Chỉ Chủ toạ hoặc Thư ký được tải bản ghi và bản gỡ băng về."); no file.

preconditions: Meeting sensitivity is Secret; transcript is Completed; actor is the current chair.
cases.inputs: recordingId: a recording of a Secret meeting; actorId: the current chair.
cases.return: Failure SecretMeeting (MSG356 "Bản ghi và bản gỡ băng của cuộc họp Mật không được tải về."); no file.

preconditions: Transcript is Completed with no segments; actor is the current chair.
cases.inputs: recordingId: a recording with an empty Completed transcript; actorId: the current chair.
cases.return: Success; the file holds only the header and no lines.
cases.log: Saved: audit row records the export with segment count 0.
